title: Very happy
text: Very happy. Had to remove the front of the fireplace to get the insert it. Easy to install once the front was removed. Reinstalled the front but left off the doors. The glass doors cannot be closed once the heater is on. Wow the flames are amazing and looks very real. I am so excited.

description: When the air starts to turn crisp, and you need to keep warm in open spaces, you realize that sweaters and blankets just wont cut it. Why not add some sophistication along with the heat with the dimple electric fireplace insert. The patented 3D flame technology provides an incredibly realistic flame effect, and easily plugs into any standard household Outlet. The built-in fan forced heater distributes heat evenly and quietly.
